en.topic_title: Hong Kong doctor found guilty over fraudulently issuing over 3,700 Covid-19 vaccine exemptions
en.topic_summary:
A Hong Kong doctor accused of fraudulently issuing around 3,700 Covid-19 vaccine exemption certificates during the pandemic has been found guilty of accessing a computer with dishonest intent.



BioNTech Covid vaccine. Photo: BioNTech. 



Tai Kong-shing received his verdict at the District Court on Friday after pleading not guilty. He was also found guilty of money laundering.



A volunteer at the clinic, Kriselle Young, was also found guilty of accessing a computer with dishonest intent.
